EXTERIOR DESIGN
LASTING IMPRESSIONS
ARE ITS SPECIALTY
From first impressions to daily inspiration, Encore delivers again
and again. Buick’s signature winged grille and LED daytime running
lamps elevate the sculptural details. To further set Encore apart,
four distinctive wheel designs are available depending on your
selected trim level. Add its sporty, turbocharged performance and
you have all the style and power needed to carve your own path.
Production of Essence and Sport Touring models ended fall 2019. Models shown
throughout may not be available. See dealer for details.
